pratyazWIlikayA sahApaharate prAkpItamuzRAmbunA ॥ hftkukzivaMkzaRakawIjaWarAntarezu vastistanAMSaPalakezu ca pArSvayoSca । SUlAni nASayati vAtavalAsajAni hiNgvAdyamAdyamidamASvinasaMhitoktam ॥” hiNgvAdicUrRam ॥ * ॥ “DImAnupacaredgulmaM pratyekaYca tridozajam । sannipAtotTite gulme tridozaGno viDirhitaH ॥ SarapuNKasya lavaRaM paTyAcUrRaM samaM dvayam । SARapramARamaSnIyAccUrRaM gulmagadApaham ॥ svarjjikA SARamAnA syAttAvadeva guqaM Bavet । uBayorvvawikAM KAdedgulmAmayavinASinIm ॥ * palASavajrISiKariciYcArkatilanAlajAH । yavajaH svarjjikA ceti kzArA azwO prakIrttitAH ॥ gulmaSUlaharAH kzArA ajIrRasya ca pAcanAH .” kzArAvfkam ॥ * ॥ “sAmudraM sEnDavaM kAcaM yavakzAraH suvarccalam । waNkaRaM svarjjikAkzAraM tulyaM cUrRaM prakalpayet ॥ vajrIkzIrEravikzIrErAtape BAvayet tryaham । vezwayedarkapatreRa rudDvA BARqapuwe pacet ॥ tatkzAraM cUrRayet paScAt tryuzaRaM triPalAM taTA । yavAnI jIrako vahniScUrRamezAYca kArayet ॥ sarvvacUrRasamaM kzAraM sarvvamekatra kArayet । taccUrRaM waNkayugalaM salilena prayojayet ॥ gulme SUle taTAjIrRe SoTe sarvvodarezu ca । mande vahnAvudAvartte plIhni cApi paraM hitam ॥ vAte'Dike jalEH kozRErhitaM pitte'Dike GftEH । gomUtreRa kaPADikye kAYjikena tridozaje ॥ vajrakzAra iti KyAtaH proktaH pUrvvaM svayamBuvA । sevito harate'jIrRaM taTAjIrRaBavAn gadAn ॥” vajrakzAraH ॥ * ॥ “suvarccikA waNkamitA SARamAnArdrikApi ca । uBe BuYjIta yugapadgulmAmayanivfttaye ॥” suvArccakA sorA iti loke । “SuktikAcUrRaguwikAM waNkamAtrAM suvezwayet । guqena SARamAnena tANgilet gulmarogavAn ॥ gulmI kumArikAmAMsaM karzArdDaM goGftAnvitam । gilet GozABayAsinDusUkzmacUrRAvaDUlitam ॥ kumArikA Giuku~yArI iti loke ॥ * ॥ “vallUraM mUlakaM matsyaM SuzkaSAkAni vEdalam । na KAdedAlukaM gulmI maDurARi PalAni ca ॥ vEdalAnAM nizeDe'pi mAzakulatTayornnAtranizeDaH । iti suSrutawIkA । iti gulmADikAraH ॥ iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ aTa gulmacikitsA । Atreya uvAca । “SvayaTUtTopacArESca dozEH saMkupyate'nilaH । mandAgninA hi jaWare jAyate gulmaruN nfRAm ॥ udaraM garjjate yasya vizamAgniSca dfSyate । todo vapuzi SUlaYca vAtagulmaM vinirddiSet ॥ Sozo'ratiH sapItatvaM mandajvaranipIqitam । tamoBramapipAsArttaM gulmaM tat pittasamBavam ॥ SoPo jAqyaYca hfllAsaM tandrAlasyaM saSItakam । mandAgnirviqvibanDaSca gulmaM tat SlezmasamBavam ॥ moho viBramatA jAqyamaratikzutpipAsakam । AlasyaM nidrayA cEvaM gulmaM tat kaPapEttikam ॥ nidrAlasyaYca dAhaSca SoTAt SUlaYca sajvaram । vEvaSyamaratirjAqyaM viqbanDo vikalANgatA ॥ taTAtIsAramUrcCA ca tfzAhfllAsavepaTu । SvAso'rucirajIrRatvaM gulmaM tatsAnnipAtikam ॥ sADyaM kevaladozotTaM dvandvaM kazwena siDyati । asADyaM sannipAtotTaM vakzyAmastatpratikriyAm ॥ yakftcikitsitaYcEva kaTitaYcopacAraRam । tadbatplIhA samAKyAto na cAtra kaTitaM punaH ॥ cikitsodaragulmasya vakzyate SfRu sAmpratam । snehanaM rukzaRaYcEva pAcanaM SoDanAni ca ॥ saMSamanaM virekaYca vasti-sneha-nirUhaRam । kzaye pAnaYca cUrRAni gulmopacaraRakriyA ॥ SuRWImUrvvA paYcamUlaM laGurAsnA ca dAru ca । kvATo'sya cAvaSezaH syAt tatsamaM kzIrameva ca ॥ daDitatsamamevantu pAcayettatsamAgninA । GftaM yAvat prapaSyecca sidDamuttAryyate tataH ॥ tatkftaM pAnake'ByaNge Bojane ca pradApayet । snehaM saptadinaM yAvat tasmAcca rUkzaRaM hitam ॥ dinatrayaYca karttavyaM kaTayAmyatra kovida ! । SuRWI sOvarccalaM jIre dve vA hiNgusamanvitam ॥ kAYjikaM pAnametezAM rUkzaRaM gulmaSAntaye । gulmacikitsite kzArapAko'tra pratiyujyate ॥ kzAraM palASArjjunaSUraRasya kzAraM taTA vE sahayAvaSUkam । sOvarccalaM sinDuBavodBidaYca sAmudrajaM vApi vimiSrayecca ॥ toyaM parisrAvya viDAnato'pi yuktaM taTEtAni sadOzaDAni । paTyAgniSuRWI rajanIsurAhvaM kuzWaM viSAlA ca yavAnikA ca ॥ taTAjamodA sahajIrake dve zaqgranTikA hiNguyutaYca cUrRam । kzArodakO pAnavimiSrapAnaM nihanti sarvvARyapi kozWajAni ॥ gulmAni sarvvARi visUcikAnAM mandAgniSUlAni BagandarARAm । plIhodarAnAhamaTo vibanDaM vinASano rogacayaM narARAm ॥” iti virukzaRam ॥ * ॥ aTa virecanAni vakzyAmaH ॥ * ॥ “nAgaraM krimijit paTyA trivftA triguRAyutam । cUrRaM guMqAnvitaM deyaM vAtagulmavirecanam ॥ dantI ca BAgamekaYca dvO BAgO ca harItakI । trivftAyAstriBAgaH syAt SuRWyAScatvAra eva ca ॥ prakzipya sarvvamekatra sarvvatulyaguqena tu । vawakaM Bakzayet prAtastasyoparijalaM pivet ॥ kaTitaSca virekaSca vAtagulmopaSAntaye .” iti vAtagulmavirecanam ॥ * ॥ “pibederaRqatElaYca sarkarAkzIrasaMyutam । pittagulmavirekAya SrezWametat suKAvaham ॥ AragbaDaM prabAlAni taTEvAragbaDAni ca । viBAvyEraRqatElena tatpatrEScEva vezwayet ॥ karddamena pralipyATa aNgArezu niDApayet । susvinnaBarjjitAM tAYca Bakzayet SarkarAnvitAm ॥ virekaM pEttike gulme hitaM SudDavirecanam .” iti pittagulmavirecanam ॥ * ॥ “triPalA surasA SuRWI cUrRaM kftvA viBAvayet । snuhIkzIreRa vArEkaM guqena saha miSritam ॥ virekaH Slezmagulme ca sarvvodaravinASanam । SuRWI sOvarccalaM paTyA viqaNgaYca punarnavA ॥ cUrRo'pAmArgavIjAnAM snuhIkzIreRa BAvitaH । guqena saMyutaM KAdet paScAt sozRaM jalaM pibet ॥ virekaH sarvvagulmezu praSasto hitakArakaH ॥ iti virecanam । SuktikzAraniSAviSAlakadalI syAt SUraRaM kokilA pAlASaM dahanArjjunaM SaWijayA'pAmArgakuzmARqakam । dagDvAkzAravipAcitaM pariSftaM hiNgutrikawvanvitaM gulmAnAhavibanDaSUlaharaRaM sarvvodarARAM hitam ॥ a: गुल्मः, --ल्मं — [गुड् मक् डस्य लः Tv.] 1 A clump or cluster of trees, a thicket, wood, bush; Ms. 1. 48; 7. 192; 12. 58; Y. 2. 229. --2 A troop of soldiers, a division of an army, consisting of 45 foot, 27 horse, 9 chariots and 9 elephants. --3 A fort. --4 The spleen. --5 A chronic enlargement of the spleen. --6 A village police-station. --7 A wharf of stairs (Mar. घांट). --8 Disciplining an army, keeping it in a posture of defence. --ल्मी 1 A cluster or clump of trees. --2 Jujube. --3 Small cardamoms. --4 A tent. --Comp. --केतुः a small sort of cane, sorrel. --केश a. having bushy hair. --मूलं fresh ginger. --वातः, --उदरः a disease of the spleen.

k.v: अप्रकाण्डे स्तम्बगुल्मौ वल्ली तु व्रततिर्लता । लता प्रतानिनी वीरुद्गुल्मिन्युलप इत्यपि॥
अन्त्रं पुरीतद्गुल्मस्तु प्लीहा पुंस्यथ वस्नसा। स्नायुः स्त्रियां कालखण्डयकृती तु समे इमे॥
सेनामुखं गुल्मगणौ वाहिनी पृतना चमूः। अनीकिनी दशानीकिन्यक्षौहिण्यथ सम्पदि॥
उष्णोऽपि घर्मचेष्टालङ्कारे भ्रान्तौ च विभ्रमः। गुल्मारुक्स्तम्बसेनाश्च जामिः स्वसृकुलस्त्रियोः॥
